Hi Samir / Olivia,

Thanks again for the interest — excited to get a live run of the platform with your team. I pulled a couple of slots that should align with our EU engineering hosts (CEST) and your stated preference for morning ET time:

- Option A: Wed May 19, 2027 — 09:30 AM ET / 15:30 CEST (60 min)
- Option B: Wed May 19, 2027 — 07:30 AM ET / 13:30 CEST (60 min)

I realize Option B is earlier on the US side; we can do 13:30 CEST if that helps you avoid the mid-morning conflict. If neither works I can propose late-afternoon ET as a backup and record.

Attached is a one-page proposed agenda and a short pre-demo checklist for your ops folks to glance at.
